articles.title: India, South Africa hold first Army-to-Army Staff Talks, focus on training and capacity building
articles.summary: India and South Africa held their inaugural Army-to-Army Staff Talks in New Delhi, aiming to significantly enhance bilateral defence cooperation. Discussions focused on boosting training exchanges, joint exercises, and strategic collaboration. This marks a pivotal step towards strengthening military ties and fostering greater interoperability and mutual understanding between the two nations.

articles.title: 1965 Indo-Pak war hero Flight Lieutenant A T Cooke dies, IAF pays tribute
articles.summary: Flight Lieutenant Alfred Tyrone Cooke (retd), a distinguished hero of the 1965 India-Pakistan War, has passed away. His legendary dogfight over Kalaikunda during the conflict is widely recognized as a "masterclass in aggressive air combat." Cooke's bravery and exceptional piloting skills embody the spirit of the Indian Air Force, serving as a powerful inspiration for aspiring defence personnel and highlighting the critical importance of air superiority.

articles.title: Drone incidents near UK military sites rise sharply: media
articles.summary: British military sites were targeted by drones over 300 times, specifically 340 incidents, in the past year, as reported by UK media. This highlights a significant and evolving security challenge from unmanned aerial systems (UAS) to critical defence infrastructure. For future officers, this underscores the increasing importance of counter-drone measures and robust perimeter security in modern defence strategies.

articles.title: NIBE Group signs MoU with Naval Group, France
articles.summary: India's NIBE Group and France's Naval Group have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to collaborate on modern technologies for India's naval programs. This strategic partnership establishes a formal framework for cooperation, aiming to enhance India's indigenous defence manufacturing capabilities and integrate advanced French naval technology. The initiative supports India's naval modernization efforts and aligns with its self-reliance goals in defence.

articles.title: PM Modi says over 51,000 youth receive appointment letters, highlights employment opportunities
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced that over 51,000 young people nationwide received appointment letters for government service under the 20th Rozgar Mela. This initiative, part of a broader government drive, aims to empower youth by providing employment opportunities across various departments, demonstrating a significant commitment to job creation and national development.

articles.title: 'Reporting fake news': Trump bars CNN, MS NOW, Politico from White House; threatens more bans
